title: Google Opens Public AI Media Detector for OpenAI and Nvidia

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A global verification portal now lets any user determine if a digital file was produced by artificial intelligence. Launched by Google as the SynthID Detector, the tool identifies media created by Google, OpenAI, Nvidia and Kakao, with Apple joining as a partner in the near future. The platform supports dozens of common file formats for images, audio and video and is currently available in English to increase the transparency of synthetic content.

Google has used SynthID to watermark more than 180 billion images and videos and 240,000 years of audio content since the technology launched in 2023. The company currently manages over 1 million verification requests every day through existing features integrated into Chrome, Search and Gemini.

Since first launching SynthID in 2023, we've watermarked more than 180 billion images and videos, along with 240,000 years of audio content.

This tool joins our built-in verification features in Search, @GeminiApp, and @GoogleChrome, which now regularly handle more than 1 million verification requests daily.

The SynthID Detector platform is part of our ongoing work to give you more context about the media you see online, so you can navigate the web with confidence.

Learn more ↓ https://t.co/ftcZtLw3vC
